description.en: Gives a conversation topic (wadai = topic), which the game stores as an item: RunGetItemEx(_item, _num, 30, 30, "J_08", 0, "system-topic-get"). The BGM is stopped with a fade of 30, the function waits 30 frames, and the jingle J_08 plays while the message shows. No shipped script calls it.

examples.case: Getting a topic (not found in script_clean/; invented)
